mathematical_authority.affine_point_identity: For source point P on selected circle center C, the retained offset point is Q=s*P+(1-s)*C+T. All coefficients and coordinates remain hyperreal::Real.
mathematical_authority.zero_translation_incidence: When T=0, |Q-C|^2-r^2 is signed exactly as s^2*r0^2-r^2 for every retained source type.
mathematical_authority.general_incidence: The selected circle first asks a correlated derived point for its exact quotient-ring identity; otherwise it refines independent exact point and center boxes and signs the complete interval for |P-C|^2-r^2.
mathematical_authority.linear_order: Projection order between two retained points refines their independent exact boxes against one represented linear form. Exact-endpoint and correlated-chord cases retain their existing specialized routes.
mathematical_authority.endpoint_tangent: For radial R=P-C and represented V, clockwise tangent T satisfies sign(T cross V)=sign(R dot V); counterclockwise and reversed traversal negate the sign exactly.
mathematical_authority.adjacent_bevel: If a chord shares one circle endpoint and its other endpoint is strictly inside the supporting disk, disk convexity proves every open chord point is interior, so the shared endpoint is the only circle/chord contact.
mathematical_authority.persistent_representation: Public retained point and CurveRegion2 handles remain one Arc word. Generic mapped sources enlarge only private derived-point allocations and share their retained parameter and source point through Arc-backed evidence.

policy_evidence.strict: Every supportable fixture decision is derived from exact Real arithmetic, retained selected-root evidence, quotient-ring identities, or strict interval separation. Terminal overlap remains Uncertain under STRICT.
policy_evidence.approximate_512: Only an unresolved equality after the 512-step terminal refinement may become equality, and the shared policy observer records Approximate512Consumed. No approximate value is retained as geometry or reusable construction evidence.
policy_evidence.fixture_outcome: The mapped-cap offset is Certified under both STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512, so the supportable fixture consumes no approximate terminal.
policy_evidence.failure_semantics: Missing point, ordering, tangent, or incidence proof remains explicit Unsupported/Ordering/Predicate uncertainty; no guessed Boolean or offset topology is published.

benchmark_method.regression_wall: Nine alternating pinned CPU 11 process pairs, one Runner sample per process, eight timed operations after the Runner warm-up; final sanity uses seven calibrated 100 ms samples per executable.
benchmark_method.regression_perf: perf stat -r 5, 32 timed operations plus one Runner warm-up; subtract the implementation-filter=disabled process and divide by 33.
benchmark_method.regression_heap: Heaptrack record-only, 32 timed operations plus one Runner warm-up; subtract the disabled process and divide by 33.
benchmark_method.capability_wall: Nine fresh pinned CPU 11 processes per implementation, 64 timed operations, one warm-up, and one preflight.
benchmark_method.capability_perf: perf stat -r 5, 256 timed operations, one warm-up, and one preflight; subtract the matched disabled process and divide by 258.
benchmark_method.capability_heap: Heaptrack record-only, 128 timed operations, one warm-up, and one preflight; subtract the matched disabled process and divide by 130.
benchmark_method.competitive_caveat: Cavalier Contours 0.7.0 receives the binary64 bulge representation of the same arc/chord cap. It provides neither exact selected fields nor policy outcomes, retained proof evidence, certified topology, or equivalent regularization guarantees.
benchmark_method.historical_caveat: afc6ec9 stops at unsupported offset construction. Its microsecond result is rejection latency, not a correctness-equivalent performance result.
